review_summary: Comprehensive independent external audit of 9702_m22_42 Question 4 across all 4 answerable leaves: (a) electric field line definition correctly identifying the direction of force acting on a positive charge (2 marks, B1 + B1), (b)(i) algebraic and numerical formulation for electric potential superposition V = Q / (4πε₀r) = 0 leading to 4.0(0.120 - x) = 7.2x and yielding distance x = 0.043 m with appropriate tolerance (2 marks, C1 + A1), (b)(ii) qualitative deduction explaining that electric field strength is non-zero because the field vectors from positive charge P (directed away from P towards Q) and negative charge Q (directed towards Q) point in the same direction and reinforce rather than cancel (1 mark, B1), and (b)(iii) vector force construction on an electron at point X showing resultant force directed leftwards between the extension of line QX and the horizontal axis towards P (1 mark, B1). All syllabus taxonomy tags, skill IDs, formula references, definitions, progressive hints, mathematical walkthroughs, response schemas, and AI rubric criteria strictly adhere to Cambridge International AS & A Level Physics standards.
